raw_text:
RESEARCH VERDICT

Verdict: caution  
Risk: medium  
Confidence: 0.62  
Rationale: Research weakens the buy: FY2025 FCF of $4.2bn (4.3× cover) was working-capital boosted; TTM FCF to Sep-2026 is ~$0.35bn vs ~$1.0bn dividends (0.3×), with the rebound biofuel-cyclical.  
RiskTags: cyclical, regulatory, governance, litigation, accounting

Screen reconciliation (does not replace the buy signal): `screening_snapshot.json` is a buy with `families_passed` 0, empty models, `data_quality_score` 0.0, and all dividend-family overlays false (`interim_dividend_cut_flagged` false). `adjusted_signal` is null, so no overlay haircut is recorded. Screen `cashflow_metrics` FCF of $4,204m matches FY2025 SEC XBRL, not the later run-rate: filing-reconcilable TTM FCF to 30 Sep 2026 is $346m (Yahoo TTM in the snapshot), versus TTM dividends of about $1,008m (FY2025 $987m plus nine-month 2026 $764m less nine-month 2025 $743m), or 0.3× cover. Nine-month 2026 statutory FCF ($1,788m OCF less $773m PP&E capex) still covers the $764m dividend at about 1.3×, so the hole is the TTM/WC swing rather than an interim cut. Investegate Admiral Group items in the filings index are the wrong issuer and were not used.

EVIDENCE
- [filings/bodies/adb01c0e0ac93bc6.txt] "Cash flows provided by operating activities of $5.5 billion, with cash flows from operations before working capital 1,3 of $2.7 billion" — FY2025 OCF that the screen uses was inflated by a ~$2.8bn working-capital inflow.
- [filings/bodies/e7d8dfc9423bb122.txt] "Net cash provided by operating activities 1,788 5,765" — Nine-month 2026 OCF of $1,788m versus $5,765m a year earlier; combining with FY2025 XBRL gives TTM OCF of $1,475m.
- [filings/bodies/e7d8dfc9423bb122.txt] "Capital expenditures ( 773 ) ( 892 )" — Nine-month 2026 PP&E capex; with FY2025 capex of $1,248m this reconciles to TTM capex of $1,129m and TTM FCF of $346m, below 1.0× the dividend.
- [filings/bodies/e7d8dfc9423bb122.txt] "Cash dividends ( 764 ) ( 743 )" — Dividend was maintained (and, per the FY2025 8-K, increased); cover is the issue, not a cut. Screen dividend-family overlays correctly did not pass.
- [filings/bodies/8945993cd70e77f4.txt] "These results were driven by a constructive biofuels environment combined with our extensive North American footprint" — 2026 earnings recovery is concentrated in a policy-sensitive crush/ethanol cycle, not yet matched by TTM cash.
- [filings/bodies/cd76d14192943d59.txt] "the Company has restated its Consolidated Financial Statements as of December 31, 2023 and 2022 and for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2022 and 2021" — Nutrition intersegment accounting restatement remains a governance/accounting overhang; 2025 10-K Item 3/Note 20 status is unknown in the truncated extracts.
- [filings/bodies/22b360c0cfe57148.txt] "The Company cannot predict when the SEC and DOJ investigations will be completed, nor can it predict the results of these investigations with any reasonable degree of certainty." — As of the FY2024 10-K, SEC/DOJ Nutrition investigations were open; later resolution is not in the supplied 2025–26 extracts.
- [filings/bodies/19af0fa0680ee358.txt] "As of December 31, 2025, the three major credit rating agencies maintained the Company’s credit ratings at investment grade levels with a negative outlook." — Liquidity is supported by unused lines, but ratings remain on negative outlook.

NUMBERS
- operating_cashflow | 5452000000.0 | FY2025 (period_end 2025-12-31, 10-K filed 2026-02-17) | [sec_companyfacts.json]
- free_cashflow | 4204000000.0 | FY2025 (OCF − PP&E capex) | [sec_companyfacts.json]
- dividends_paid | 987000000.0 | FY2025 | [sec_companyfacts.json]
- Net cash provided by operating activities | 1,788 | Nine months ended 30 Sep 2026 | [filings/bodies/e7d8dfc9423bb122.txt]
- Capital expenditures | ( 773 ) | Nine months ended 30 Sep 2026 | [filings/bodies/e7d8dfc9423bb122.txt]
- Cash dividends | ( 764 ) | Nine months ended 30 Sep 2026 | [filings/bodies/e7d8dfc9423bb122.txt]

THESIS BREAKS
- A full-year period in which statutory FCF (OCF − PP&E capex) stays below 1.0× dividends paid and the Board cuts or suspends the dividend.
- An SEC/DOJ resolution or further restatement that imposes a material fine, additional control failure, or restatement of 2025–26 results.
- A reversal of U.S. biofuel policy (including Section 45Z / RVO) that collapses crush and ethanol margins after the 2026 guidance raises.
- Loss of investment-grade ratings sufficient to shut the commercial-paper market, given working-capital intensity and the negative outlook already disclosed.
